messages:
maya: Heads up: planning a schema migration on orders.events to add customer_segment in the midnight change window (00:00-01:00 UTC) tomorrow. I'll queue the migration + chunked backfill. Needs a short lock for the DDL. I plan to pin the API to v1.8 for ~2h. Any objections?

sam: Do we need an exclusive lock for ADD COLUMN? Can we do ADD COLUMN NULL then fill? Also what's the backfill strategy — streaming vs batch?

eli: Recommend copy+swap to avoid long locks: create a new table, copy in chunks, then swap with rename + triggers to keep writes consistent. Quick example: ```sql
CREATE TABLE events_new (LIKE events INCLUDING ALL);
-- copy in chunks, then swap names and recreate constraints/indexes
```
This avoids holding an exclusive lock on the primary table during copy.

carla: Copy+swap sounds safest. Watch FK constraints and indexes — they need to be re-applied after swap. Also please add the API version pin to the release notes + rollout config @maya. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: [1749001300] Release candidate 2024.3.17-rc5 queued for service: orders. Rollout policy: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m checks. Migrations: orders.events:add_column_customer_segment (requires short lock).

maya: I'll hold canary at 0% until backfill makes progress. Plan: run migration to add nullable column (no default) at 00:00 UTC — instant. Start chunked backfill at 00:02 UTC with 10k rows/txn, app pinned to v1.8. Will post backfill job IDs here.

ops-oncall: Make sure to set the maintenance window on status page and ping CS. Also check we don't exceed 10% RPS delta for the canary.

db-migrations-bot: db-migrations-bot: migration orders.events:add_column_customer_segment started bymaya (job 4821). estimated lock time: 3s. acquiring lock...

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary blocked at 0% because backfill job running. Use `/deploy force` to override.

sam: If the backfill slows, prefer gradual rollout + async fillers rather than rollback. Rolling back would drop the column and complicate things.

carla: Agreed. Also add a feature flag to hide new field from clients until fully populated — safer fallback.

maya: Backfill job IDs: 4821(copy), 4822(chunker-00..05). Starting chunk 0/5 now. Logs: ```INFO copied 10000 rows in 14s```

db-migrations-bot: chunk 0 completed. chunk 1 started. progress 20%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary resumed to 10% now that first chunk completed. Observability: latency +0.7%.

eli: Noticed a tail latency bump on replicas — likely vacuuming from large inserts. Suggest throttle to 5k rows/txn for next chunks.

maya: Throttling to 5k/txn for next chunks. Pausing canary growth until 60% progress.

db-migrations-bot: chunk 2 failed: detected deadlock on events_shard_3, retrying with exponential backoff.

sam: If retries keep failing we should abort migration and revert any partial code changes. How long to rollback the canary? ~15m to revert to previous rollout config?

maya: Retry succeeded after bumping lock_timeout. chunk 2 completed. progress 60%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary at 50%. No errors in error budget. Awaiting final approval for 100%.

carla: QA verified canary — no data regressions observed. Approving full rollout. :white_check_mark: 

maya: Backfill complete. Finalizing index rebuild and rename swap. Will unpin API after +2h from migration start. Release note draft: "orders: add customer_segment column (nullable) + background backfill"

db-migrations-bot: migration completed successfully. job 4821 finished. locks released.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% started. Release 2024.3.17-rc5 -> prod complete. :tada: 

ops-oncall: Monitoring for 30m post-deploy. Will escalate to #incidents if P95 latency >2x baseline.
